console.cancelled: The recording was cancelled: the console stopped watching that source
console.dropped: {n, number} not delivered (too many at once)
console.emptyRedacted: Pick a source to watch. Hive captures a source only while this window watches it, and what it captures is redacted: no prompt or reply text, commands, tokens or sign-in details.
console.emptyText: Pick a source to watch. Hive captures a source only while this window watches it, and what it captures is redacted: no tokens or sign-in details (this window shows prompt, reply and command text while the setting is on).
console.events: {n, plural, one {# event} other {# events}}{cleared, select, yes { (cleared)} other {}}
console.eventsOf: {shown, number} of {n, plural, one {# event} other {# events}}{cleared, select, yes { (cleared)} other {}}
console.failed: Recording failed after {n, plural, one {# event} other {# events}} in {name}: {error}
console.fileFull: The recording file took nothing more
console.includeText: Include prompt and reply text in this recording (tokens and sign-ins stay masked)
console.outlineTip: Cut down to its outline (too large)
console.recordWhat: Record {source} to a file, from now until you stop. Redacted unless you tick text: no prompt or reply text, commands, tokens or sign-ins.
console.recording: Recording {n, plural, one {# event} other {# events}} to {name}{withText, select, yes { (with text)} other {}}
console.redactedStatus: Redacted: no prompt or reply text, commands, tokens or sign-ins
console.saved: Saved {n, plural, one {# event} other {# events}} to {name}{limit, select, yes { (it reached its size limit)} other {}}
console.tooMany: Too many developer consoles open at once
console.unredacted: Unredacted: this console shows prompt, reply and command text (Settings → Advanced → Developer console: show prompt, reply and command text). Tokens, API keys and sign-in details stay masked.
console.unredactedStatus: Unredacted: text shown; tokens and sign-ins masked
